caption: The drawing depicts a curved, brown comb positioned diagonally across the center of a light beige or off-white background. The comb has a solid, slightly arched spine and a series of evenly spaced, tapered teeth that project from the spine. The teeth are colored in shades of brown and ochre, with some variations in tone that suggest a natural material. There are no additional objects in the image, and the overall composition is simple and uncluttered, with the comb standing as the single central subject. A faint rectangular border frames the drawing, and in the bottom left corner, there is small, handwritten text that reads: "Edith H. McNight."
title: Comb
